# Keshira Ayurvedic Haircare

> Hand-poured Ayurvedic herbal hair shampoos and hair oils formulated with 14 sacred active botanicals at scalp-optimal pH 5.5. 100% sulfate-free, paraben-free, cruelty-free, and micro-batched in India.

## Core Products
- **Keshira Neem Herbal Shampoo**: Anti-microbial dandruff control and flaky scalp relief formulated with Neem, Rosemary Oil, Shikakai, and Fenugreek. Scalp barrier pH 5.5.
- **Keshira Hibiscus Herbal Shampoo**: Root-strengthening and anti-breakage hair fall reduction formulated with Hibiscus petals, Bhringraj, Amla, and Curry Leaves.
- **Keshira Gentle Herbal Shampoo**: Ultra-mild daily cleanser and color-safe formula powered by pure Aritha (soapnut saponins), Aloe Vera, and Flaxseed gel.
- **Keshira Herbal Oil**: Traditional 14-herb pre-wash scalp oil slow-cooked in cold-pressed sesame oil with Bhringraj, Brahmi, Rosemary, and Kalonji (Black Seed).

## Key Differentiators
- **pH 5.5 Acid Mantle Preservation**: Prevents cuticle swelling, dryness, and Malassezia fungal overgrowth.
- **Zero Chemical Foaming Agents**: Free from SLS, SLES, silicones, phthalates, parabens, and synthetic dyes. Cleanses using natural Aritha and Shikakai plant saponins.
- **Micro-Batch Freshness**: Hand-crafted in small weekly batches for botanical freshness and maximum phytonutrient potency.
- **Direct Offers**: Store-wide Buy 1 Get 1 Free (BOGO) and Regimen Bundles with free express delivery in India.
